paragraphs: VitalChek sells online ordering of vital records, covering birth, death, marriage and divorce certificates. The site describes the company as the exclusive online partner of over 450 governing agencies, with certificates printed and shipped from the government location that issues them. Identity validation on most orders is attributed to LexisNexis.

The described process starts with an online form, after which the request is sent to the agency that issues the certificate. The certificate is then shipped directly to the person who ordered it by that issuing agency. The page puts volume at 4 million documents annually. The page also states that shipping this way costs about 50% less than standard overnight shipping.

quote.text: VitalChek is the exclusive online partner of over 450 governing agencies
